title: SC2 inspired RTS I have been working on for 1 week
author: AdneAoe
selftext: First time I played it 1v1, worked fine!

comments.author: thirsty_pretzelzz
comments.body: Great stuff! The animations look so smooth, what tool are you using for them?

replies.author: AdneAoe
replies.body:
Everything is created with just Claude Code, for the 3d parts I always ask Fable with Opus 5 subagents. Everything you see in 3d is threeJS, so no gltf/glb or files like that. 

The animations are just pure math functions with some pivots, not stuff I could've ever created myself though, it's all Claude coming up with some smart solution that it's reusing for all units.
